title: base-client: generic PushSubscription/get and /set bindings on JmapClient
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E11. Crates: jmap-base-client. Size: S.

Spec: RFC 8620 §7.2.1, §7.2.2; draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-05 §4 (capability in using). Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §8, decision 8 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md.

Add JmapClient::push_subscription_get(ids, properties, extra_using) and push_subscription_set(create, update, destroy, extra_using), typed on jmap_types::PushSubscription (crate-jmap-base-client push.rs/client.rs). extra_using adds capability URIs such as urn:ietf:params:jmap:emailpush to the request's using. No accountId (PushSubscription has none). No conditional arguments: rustdoc points to the conditional epic's generic SetCall for ifUnchangedBy/atomic (decision 8).
Acceptance: request serialization tests against RFC 8620 §7.2 example JSON; extra_using appears in using; responses decode, including created/updated echoes with extra keys. Public-api snapshot refreshed, CHANGELOG entry.
